spec.objective: Repair a deterministic stale-document checker defect in an isolated fixture project.

criteria.statement: The run starts from this GoalContract instead of a fixed task list.
Acceptance Claims and Gates are produced before PlanIR execution.
The fixture exposes a deterministic stale-document defect and repairs it.
Repair changes only the affected doc-health component.
Unauthorized writes are denied before side effects and audited.
The PlanIR execution can resume from a checkpoint.
The second verification selects fewer Gates than the full Gate set and reuses current Evidence.
L2 completion accepts only when every required Claim has current Evidence.
